episode.title: Petra Treasury Was Carved Top Downward

synopsis: Masons sculpted the iconic facade of Petra's Treasury from the top of the cliff downward.

Shot 1, exactly 10 seconds at 24 fps, ONE continuous unbroken shot with no cuts. title_card.title: Petra Treasury was carved top down.
title_card.subtitle: Masons cut the cliff facade from above.

caption:
Petra's famous Treasury building was carved from the top of the cliff downward.

Rediscovered by travellers in 1812, the rose-red facade was sculpted directly into the rock face by Nabataean stonemasons. Working from wooden scaffolding above, workers avoided needing lower supports.
